For thousands of years, many poems and paintings have been created to praise the peony. In
the Tang Dynasty, peonies were widely planted in royal gardens and were regarded as nation-
al flowers, so they became particularly popular. In the tenth century, Luoyang became a cen-
ter of peony cultivation, and this status has maintained to today. Now, thousands of domestic
visitors flock to Luoyang to participate in the annual Peony Festival. They enjoy the unique
beauty of Luoyang peony, and explore the history of this ancient capital of nine dynasties.
